sources.description: Two relevant exposures and a shared inhibition/substrate pathway require review; reviewed narrow-index classification prioritizes it. Not a clinical guideline.
Invented people, episodes and exposure records; no actual patient data.
Bounded educational modeling decisions and admission policy; not a quotation or claim of complete legal or clinical requirements.

assertions.meaning: Admitted evidence relation record.
Admitted evidence relation part.
Admitted evidence relation member.
The fit relation is derived, never accepted as an ordinary evidence fact.
The obliged relation is derived, never accepted as an ordinary evidence fact.

assertions.statement: all $a, $ep, $pair, $s, $i, $e, $ir, $sr: record($a, $ep, $pair, AssessmentRegister) & record($pair, $s, $i, InteractionPairs) & record($ir, $i, $e, MechanismRegister) & member($ir, InhibitionEdges) & record($sr, $s, $e, MechanismRegister) & member($sr, SubstrateEdges) -> fit($a, SharedMechanism, ScreeningPolicy).
assertions.meaning: The assessment fits the shared-enzyme criterion; this is a mechanism match, not a concentration measurement.

assertions.statement: all $a, $ep, $pair, $p, $s, $i, $xi, $xs: record($a, $ep, $pair, AssessmentRegister) & record($ep, $p, MedicationReview, EpisodeRegister) & record($pair, $s, $i, InteractionPairs) & record($xi, $i, $p, ExposureRegister) & part($xi, $ep) & member($xi, RelevantExposures) & record($xs, $s, $p, ExposureRegister) & part($xs, $ep) & member($xs, RelevantExposures) -> fit($a, ConcurrentExposure, ScreeningPolicy).
assertions.meaning: Both relevant exposures must match the same patient and episode; a prescription-stop record does not remove residual exposure.

assertions.statement: all $a, $action: fit($a, SharedMechanism, ScreeningPolicy) & fit($a, ConcurrentExposure, ScreeningPolicy) & part($action, $a) & member($action, InteractionReviewActions) -> obliged(ReviewTeam, $action, ScreeningPolicy).
assertions.meaning: The fictional screening policy requires a review; it does not diagnose toxicity or prescribe treatment.

assertions.statement: all $a, $ep, $pair, $s, $i, $action: record($a, $ep, $pair, AssessmentRegister) & record($pair, $s, $i, InteractionPairs) & member($s, NarrowTherapeuticIndexDrugs) & fit($a, SharedMechanism, ScreeningPolicy) & fit($a, ConcurrentExposure, ScreeningPolicy) & part($action, $a) & member($action, PriorityReviewActions) -> obliged(ReviewTeam, $action, PriorityScreeningPolicy).
